topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes, histopathology practical context, and learning objectives.

topics.label: Tumor virology and cellular transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the discovery of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for cell transformation.

topics.label: Cancer gene classifications, allele dosage, and tumor suppressor pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the functional definitions, signaling pathways, and allelic mutation dynamics of oncogenes and tumor suppressors.

topics.label: Mechanisms and cellular consequences of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in DNA repair pathways, replication proofreading, and mitotic chromosome segregation generate sequence and chromosomal instability.

topics.label: Multi-step progression, hereditary cancer syndromes, and tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how sequential somatic mutations and inherited cancer predispositions drive tumor development and subsequent evolution.
